prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1324; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear impact sustained while turning left at low speed, reporting neck and back pain with associated stiffness. Over the course of treatment, the patient completed twelve visits consisting of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and home exercise instruction. Cervical and lumbar range of motion was limited, with paraspinal muscle tenderness noted on palpation, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength were within normal limits. Recovery has been gradual, and the course of care extended somewhat beyond what is typical for a strain of this type. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is documented in the available history. At this time, it is not yet clear whether the presenting symptoms are fully attributable to this collision, and further correlation with imaging and prior records may be helpful. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries.
